messages.subject: Project Quartz - SPA mark-up (limitations)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up follows separately, but to flag the headline points now: the 20% cap is too high for a W&I-backed deal - our clients expect a cap at or near the premium plus a nominal sum. We can live with 15% as a staging post but will push lower. We also want the general warranty period down to 18 months from 24, and a non-compete of no more than 24 months.

Eleanor
